## Codex execution contract

**CGS-17 QA evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional and disclose when unavailable. A native delegate must actually run to be independent; otherwise use an explicitly labelled in-session fallback. Prior user authorization and host permissions govern all writes. Resolve the actual workflow and QA levels separately. Minimal may waive automated test requirements but never removes Visual/Feel or UI screenshot evidence; standard retains per-story requirements and full adds coverage targets. Report unavailable inputs as NOT ASSESSED.
